title: The Long Way Round
summary: The carters won't take the barrows road any more, and Maudry Fenn pays for it in the price of everything she pours. She wants the walking kind knocked back.

steps.journal: Go down into the Old Barrows. Win four fights, and open one of their chests.

objectives.label: Waves held in the Old Barrows
Chests opened in the Old Barrows

ready: Go back to Maudry Fenn at the Tired Mule.
done: The carters complain about something else now.
